en: An old sepia-toned postcard featuring a rural scene in Oberlößnitz-Radebeul, showing a well-maintained path lined with young trees, greenhouses, and a vineyard landscape on a hillside. In the foreground, two people in period clothing stand beside the path. At the end of the path is a large villa, and another villa is visible on the hillside. The text mentions Pietzsch's Gärtnerei (nursery/garden center).
